properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign JWT access tokens.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT access token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.upload.dir
properties.description: Directory where uploaded resume PDFs are stored.

properties.name: app.upload.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum accepted resume PDF size in bytes.

properties.name: app.ai.model
properties.description: Gemini model name used for resume analysis.

properties.name: app.ai.temperature
properties.description: Sampling temperature used for AI resume analysis.

properties.name: app.ai.max-resume-characters
properties.description: Maximum number of resume text characters sent to the AI model.

properties.name: app.ai.max-job-description-characters
properties.description: Maximum number of job-description characters sent to the AI model.

properties.name: app.ai.max-job-match-input-characters
properties.description: Maximum combined resume and job-description characters sent to the AI model for matching.

properties.name: app.rag.embedding-model
properties.description: Google GenAI embedding model used for resume RAG indexing and retrieval.

properties.name: app.rag.embedding-dimensions
properties.description: Number of embedding dimensions requested from Gemini and expected by pgvector.

properties.name: app.rag.vector-table-name
properties.description: PostgreSQL pgvector table used for resume chunks.

properties.name: app.rag.chunk-size
properties.description: Target character size for resume RAG chunks.

properties.name: app.rag.chunk-overlap
properties.description: Character overlap between adjacent resume RAG chunks.

properties.name: app.rag.top-k
properties.description: Maximum number of resume chunks retrieved for one chat question.

properties.name: app.rag.similarity-threshold
properties.description: Minimum vector similarity score accepted for resume chat retrieval.

properties.name: app.rag.max-question-length
properties.description: Maximum accepted resume chat question length.

properties.name: app.rag.source-excerpt-length
properties.description: Maximum source excerpt length returned with resume chat citations.
